components.name: affix
components.description: Affixes content to a window or scroll container boundary.

usage.description: Affixes content to a window or scroll container boundary.

components.name: alert
components.description: Displays important contextual feedback messages with semantic status types.

usage.description: Use Alert for persistent, page-level feedback about a state or operation. Use Sonner toasts for transient notifications.
bestPractices: Pick the semantic type that matches the severity of the message.
Keep the title short; put detail in the description.
Enable showIcon when the alert needs to be scannable at a glance.
avoid: Do not stack many alerts in one view; prefer a single summary.
Do not use Alert for transient feedback; use a toast instead.

props.name: type
props.description: Semantic status type controlling colors and default icon.

props.name: title
props.description: Bold heading line of the alert.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text rendered below the title.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Whether to render the per-type status icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon overriding the per-type default.

props.name: closable
props.description: Whether to show a close button that dismisses the alert.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the close button is clicked.

props.name: action
props.description: Right-side action slot, e.g. a button.

components.name: app
components.description: Scopes imperative messages, notifications and confirmation dialogs to the current React tree and TaoProvider theme.

usage.description: Place App below TaoProvider, then call App.useApp() from descendant components. Messages return callable close handles that can be awaited; confirmation dialogs return update, destroy and then.
bestPractices: Create feedback in event handlers or effects.
Await modal confirmation when the next action depends on the user’s choice.
Keep an App instance mounted for the lifetime of its feedback.
avoid: Do not call App.useApp() above its App provider.
Do not use transient messages for information that must remain available.

components.name: auto-complete
components.description: Editable text input with searchable suggestions, keyboard completion and custom input support.

usage.description: Use AutoComplete when free-form input is valid and suggestions help users finish typing.
bestPractices: Control value with onChange and fetch suggestions with onSearch.
Provide stable values and concise option labels.
Give custom input elements an accessible name.
avoid: Do not use onSearch as the only controlled-value update during composition.
Use Select when users must choose from a closed list.

components.name: avatar
components.description: Represents people with images, icons or automatically fitted initials.

usage.description: Use Avatar for a person or account; group related people with Avatar.Group.
bestPractices: Provide meaningful image alternative text.
Supply initials or an icon as an image fallback.
avoid: Do not rely on an image alone to identify an account.

components.name: badge
components.description: Adds notification counts, status indicators or a ribbon to content.

usage.description: Use Badge for compact counts or a status next to a label.
bestPractices: Pair status colors with meaningful text.
avoid: Do not use a count badge for long descriptions.

components.name: border-beam
components.description: Animates a highlighted beam around the border of its child.

usage.description: Animates a highlighted beam around the border of its child.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.description: Renders the user location in a hierarchy of pages or views.

usage.description: Use Breadcrumb near the top of a page when users need to understand or move through nested context.
bestPractices: Keep labels short and recognizable.
Use links for ancestors and plain text for the current item.
avoid: Do not use Breadcrumb as primary navigation.

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered breadcrumb items.

props.name: separator
props.description: Custom separator between items.

components.name: button
components.description: Triggers an immediate action such as submitting, saving, or opening a surface.

usage.description: Use Button for explicit actions. It inherits size, disabled, and variant defaults from TaoProvider.
bestPractices: Prefer one primary action per view or decision area.
Use loading when an action is pending.
Pass a native type when using a button inside a form.
avoid: Do not use Button for simple navigation when a link is more accurate.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size, falling back to TaoProvider.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the button and sets aria-busy.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Semantic class override.

components.name: calendar
components.description: Browse a month or year and place events inside date cells.

usage.description: Use Calendar to browse schedules and select a day without opening a popup.
bestPractices: Use validRange to bound the available dates.
Use cellRender for date-specific events.
Use fullscreen=false for compact embedded calendars.
avoid: Do not mutate the Day.js values passed to callbacks.

components.name: card
components.description: Groups related content with an optional heading, cover, tabs and actions.

usage.description: Use Card for a distinct content item; Card.Meta organizes its identity and description.
bestPractices: Keep titles short and actions specific.
avoid: Do not wrap every page section in nested cards.

components.name: carousel
components.description: Swipeable slides with fade, directional dots, autoplay, arrows and imperative navigation.

usage.description: Swipeable slides with fade, directional dots, autoplay, arrows and imperative navigation.
bestPractices: Provide meaningful labels and concise content.
Keep controlled state synchronized through the change callbacks.

components.name: cascader
components.description: Choose paths through hierarchical options with search, lazy loading, multiple selection and an inline panel.

usage.description: Use Cascader when users select a complete path such as region, department or category.
bestPractices: Use stable values at each level.
Enable changeOnSelect when parent paths are valid choices.
Use Cascader.Panel when the hierarchy should stay visible.
avoid: Do not combine lazy loadData with search over unloaded options.
Do not flatten paths before handling onChange.

components.name: checkbox
components.description: Selects one or more independent boolean options.

usage.description: Use Checkbox for independent choices, or CheckboxGroup when users can select multiple options from a set.
bestPractices: Use clear labels that describe the checked state.
Group related options with CheckboxGroup.
avoid: Do not use CheckboxGroup when only one option may be selected; use RadioGroup instead.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state.

props.name: options
props.description: Options for CheckboxGroup.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Semantic class overrides.

components.name: collapsible
components.description: Shows and hides a region of content while keeping disclosure state accessible.

usage.description: Use Collapsible to hide secondary details while preserving a lightweight page layout.
bestPractices: Make the trigger label describe the hidden content.
Use controlled open state when it must coordinate with other UI.
avoid: Do not hide required form inputs in a collapsed region without a clear cue.

components.name: color-picker
components.description: Choose single or gradient colors with hex, RGB, HSB and alpha controls.

usage.description: Keep the returned Color object when precision matters and call toCssString for use in CSS.
bestPractices: Use presets for a constrained brand palette.
Use disabledAlpha when transparency is not supported.
Use onChangeComplete when a finished edit should be committed.
avoid: Do not discard the Color object during a drag if precision matters.

components.name: context-menu
components.description: Displays contextual actions from a right click or long press interaction.

usage.description: Use ContextMenu for secondary actions attached to an object or region.
bestPractices: Keep items short and action-oriented.
Provide another reachable path for critical actions.
avoid: Do not put primary workflows only inside a context menu.

components.name: date-picker
components.description: Lets users enter or choose a single date, with optional time selection.

usage.description: Use DatePicker when free text date input would be error-prone or when users benefit from calendar context.
bestPractices: Support keyboard entry for known dates.
Use presets for common relative choices when helpful.
avoid: Do not force calendar navigation for dates far in the past without typed input.

components.name: descriptions
components.description: Displays labeled record fields with responsive columns and flexible spans.

usage.description: Use Descriptions for read-only details; use Form for editable fields.

components.name: divider
components.description: Separates sections or inline actions with an optional title.

usage.description: Use a divider when spacing alone cannot explain a section boundary.
bestPractices: Use vertical dividers between short inline actions.
avoid: Do not put titles inside vertical dividers.

components.name: drawer
components.description: Opens a side panel for related tasks without leaving the current page.

usage.description: Use Drawer for inspection, editing, or supporting workflows that should stay connected to the current page.
bestPractices: Use a clear title and predictable close affordance.
Keep destructive confirmations in a dedicated confirmation step.
avoid: Do not stack multiple drawers for a single workflow.

components.name: dropdown
components.description: Opens a menu of actions or navigation choices from a trigger.

usage.description: Use Dropdown for compact action sets that do not need to stay visible.
bestPractices: Order frequent actions first.
Use destructive styling only for destructive items.
avoid: Do not use Dropdown as a replacement for visible primary navigation.

components.name: empty
components.description: Shows a localized empty state with an illustration, description and optional action.

usage.description: Shows a localized empty state with an illustration, description and optional action.
bestPractices: Explain the current state and offer a useful next action.
Keep descriptions concise and localized.
avoid: Do not replace an actionable error with an unexplained empty state.

components.name: float-button
components.description: Provides floating actions, grouped controls and a scroll-to-top action.

usage.description: Provides floating actions, grouped controls and a scroll-to-top action.

components.name: form
components.description: Collects and validates field values with an antd-aligned API (rules, dependencies, Form.List) on top of the rc-form engine.

usage.description: Use Form with Form.Item when fields need a value store, rule validation, or submit handling. Use the lighter FormField when you manage state yourself.
bestPractices: Declare validation as rules on Form.Item; the required mark is inferred from rules.
Use dependencies for cross-field rules such as password confirmation.
Use Form.useForm() for imperative control (setFieldsValue, resetFields, submit).
Set size or disabled on Form to cascade them to every control inside.
avoid: Do not bind the same name in two mounted Form.Items.
Do not mix manual value/onChange props with a bound Form.Item on the same control.

props.name: initialValues
props.description: Seed values for the form store.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Called with collected values after a valid submit.

props.name: layout
props.description: Label/control arrangement inherited by Form.Item.

props.name: Form.Item rules
props.description: Validation rules (required, pattern, min/max, validator, …), same engine as antd.

props.name: Form.Item help / extra
props.description: help overrides the rule message; extra renders a description below the control.

components.name: form-actions
components.description: Lays out submit, cancel, and secondary actions for forms.

usage.description: Use FormActions at the end of a form or section to align the final actions consistently.
bestPractices: Keep action order consistent across forms.
Use a single submit action unless the workflow truly branches.

components.name: form-field
components.description: Associates labels, help text, validation state, and controls.

usage.description: Use FormField to provide accessible labeling and status text around a single control.
bestPractices: Connect every input with a visible label.
Keep validation copy specific and actionable.

components.name: form-layout
components.description: Arranges form content with consistent label and control alignment.

usage.description: Use FormLayout to keep dense forms aligned and predictable.
bestPractices: Use one layout strategy per form.
Prefer vertical layout on narrow screens.

components.name: form-section
components.description: Groups related form fields with a title and optional description.

usage.description: Use FormSection to break long forms into scannable groups.
bestPractices: Use headings that describe the group, not the control type.
Keep each section focused on one user decision area.

components.name: headless-input-number
components.description: Headless numeric input primitives and hook for custom number entry experiences.

usage.description: Use the headless API when tao-ui styling is not appropriate but number formatting behavior should stay consistent.
bestPractices: Use useNumberInput for fully custom rendering.
Reuse the validation helpers for parity with the styled InputNumber.

components.name: image
components.description: Images with keyboard-accessible preview, grouping, transforms, fallbacks and upload progress.

usage.description: Images with keyboard-accessible preview, grouping, transforms, fallbacks and upload progress.
bestPractices: Provide meaningful labels and concise content.
Keep controlled state synchronized through the change callbacks.

components.name: input
components.description: Single-line text input for short freeform values.

usage.description: Use Input for short text values such as names, filters, search terms, and identifiers.
bestPractices: Pair with FormField for labels and validation.
Use type, inputMode, and autoComplete when applicable.

components.name: input-number
components.description: A styled numeric input built on tao-ui number formatting and validation behavior.

usage.description: Use InputNumber for numeric values that need min, max, step, precision, or formatted display.
bestPractices: Set min and max when the domain is bounded.
Use the headless API when custom rendering is required.
avoid: Do not use a numeric input for identifiers such as account numbers.

components.name: list
components.description: Displays records with metadata, actions, loading, pagination and responsive columns.

usage.description: Compose repeated content with List.Item and List.Item.Meta.
bestPractices: Supply stable row keys for changing records.
Use a responsive grid for cards and pagination for bounded pages.
avoid: Use Listy with virtualization for very large scrollable lists.

components.name: listy
components.description: Renders grouped or virtualized lists with precise item, group and position scrolling.

usage.description: Render long lists and grouped records without mounting the entire data set.
bestPractices: Provide stable rowKey values and a height when virtual is enabled.
Use scrollTo with keys when records can change order.
avoid: Do not enable virtual scrolling without a bounded height.

components.name: masonry
components.description: Arranges variable-height content in responsive balanced columns.

usage.description: Arranges variable-height content in responsive balanced columns.

components.name: mentions
components.description: Insert mentions into multiline text using configurable prefixes, search suggestions and keyboard selection.

usage.description: Use Mentions for comments and messages that refer to people, topics or identifiers.
bestPractices: Use onSearch to fetch suggestions and loading while they arrive.
Use unique option values that are meaningful in the resulting text.
Use Mentions.getMentions with the same prefix and split configuration.
avoid: Keep prefix and split consistent when parsing stored text.
Do not use labels as insertion values when identifiers differ.

components.name: modal
components.description: Displays a focused dialog for decisions, forms, and interruptive information.

usage.description: Use Modal for focused tasks or decisions. Static helpers such as Modal.confirm mirror common confirmation flows.
bestPractices: Prefer Modal.useModal inside React trees so dialogs inherit TaoProvider context.
Keep modal content short and task-oriented.
avoid: Do not use nested modals for multi-step workflows.

props.name: width
props.description: Dialog width; accepts a breakpoint map, largest matching breakpoint wins.

components.name: pagination
components.description: Moves through paged data with current page and page-size controls.

usage.description: Use Pagination when a collection is split into pages rather than infinitely loaded.
bestPractices: Keep the current page controlled when data is loaded remotely.
Show total counts when they help users judge scope.

components.name: popconfirm
components.description: Shows a compact confirmation popup anchored to a trigger element, with OK and Cancel actions.

usage.description: Use Popconfirm for lightweight inline confirmations such as delete actions, where a full Modal would be too heavy. Use Modal.confirm for critical or complex confirmations.
bestPractices: Keep the title to one short question; put detail in the description.
Use Popconfirm for reversible, low-risk actions anchored to the control that triggers them.
avoid: Do not use Popconfirm for irreversible high-risk operations; use Modal.confirm instead.
Do not put forms or rich interactions inside a Popconfirm.

props.name: title
props.description: Main question text of the confirm popup.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text shown under the title.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when OK is clicked; the popup also closes.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when Cancel is clicked; the popup also closes.

props.name: okText
props.description: Text of the OK button.

props.name: cancelText
props.description: Text of the Cancel button.

props.name: okButtonProps
props.description: Extra props forwarded to the OK button.

props.name: cancelButtonProps
props.description: Extra props forwarded to the Cancel button.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown before the title. Pass `null` to hide it. Defaults to a warning triangle.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, the trigger still renders but the popup never opens.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes.

props.name: placement
props.description: Popup side relative to the trigger.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Semantic per-part class name overrides.

props.name: styles
props.description: Semantic per-part inline style overrides.

components.name: popover
components.description: Displays a floating card with rich content anchored to a trigger element, opened by click or hover.

usage.description: Use Popover for rich, non-blocking contextual content behind a click or hover. Use Tooltip for short text-only hints and Modal for blocking interactions.
bestPractices: Keep the title to one short line; put detail in the content.
Use the default hover trigger for read-only previews and trigger="click" for interactive content.
Keep popup content compact; link out for long-form detail.
avoid: Do not nest essential workflows inside a hover-only popover.
Do not chain popovers from inside another popover.

props.name: title
props.description: Header text of the popup.

props.name: content
props.description: Body content of the popup.

props.name: trigger
props.description: How the popup opens.

props.name: placement
props.description: Popup side relative to the trigger.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes.

props.name: mouseEnterDelay
props.description: Delay in seconds before a hover opens the popup.

props.name: mouseLeaveDelay
props.description: Delay in seconds before a hover closes the popup.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Whether to render a pointing arrow on the popup.

props.name: destroyOnHidden
props.description: Unmount the popup content while closed. When false, the content is kept mounted and hidden.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Semantic per-part class name overrides.

props.name: styles
props.description: Semantic per-part inline style overrides.

components.name: progress
components.description: Shows measured completion with line, circle, dashboard or stepped progress indicators.

usage.description: Shows measured completion with line, circle, dashboard or stepped progress indicators.
bestPractices: Choose a shape that matches the content and available space.
Provide meaningful labels and real loading state.
avoid: Do not show fabricated progress or leave loading states unresolved.

components.name: qr-code
components.description: Encode a value as a canvas or SVG QR code with status and refresh controls.

usage.description: Provide a stable value and choose canvas for bitmap download or SVG for resolution-independent output.
bestPractices: Use a high-contrast foreground and background.
Keep the quiet zone clear.
Use onRefresh for expired tokens.
avoid: Do not use a large center icon with low error correction.

components.name: radio
components.description: Selects exactly one option from a mutually exclusive set.

usage.description: Use RadioGroup when every option is visible and only one can be selected.
bestPractices: Use concise labels.
Provide a default value when one option is recommended or required.
avoid: Do not use RadioGroup for very long option lists; use Select instead.

components.name: range-picker
components.description: Lets users select a start and end date as one range value.

usage.description: Use RangePicker for reporting windows, booking windows, and filters with start/end dates.
bestPractices: Use presets for common ranges such as today, this week, or last 30 days.
Make inclusive/exclusive range behavior clear when it matters.

components.name: rate
components.description: Collects or displays a rating with half steps, keyboard control and custom symbols.

usage.description: Collect or show a bounded rating.
bestPractices: Label the rating with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
Use readOnly for results and allowHalf only when precision is meaningful.
avoid: Do not rely on color alone to explain a rating scale.

components.name: result
components.description: Communicates an operation result or error page with status, explanation and next actions.

usage.description: Communicates an operation result or error page with status, explanation and next actions.
bestPractices: Explain the current state and offer a useful next action.
Keep descriptions concise and localized.
avoid: Do not replace an actionable error with an unexplained empty state.

components.name: scroll-area
components.description: Provides a styled scroll container for overflow content.

usage.description: Use ScrollArea when a fixed region needs overflow behavior without changing page scroll.
bestPractices: Constrain height explicitly.
Avoid hiding important actions below a small scroll region.

components.name: segmented
components.description: Selects one option from a compact accessible radio group.

usage.description: Use Segmented for a small set of related views or modes.

components.name: select
components.description: Chooses one value from a compact list of options.

usage.description: Use Select when choices are known but too numerous or secondary to show as radios.
bestPractices: Use RadioGroup when there are only a few important choices.
Keep option labels stable and easy to scan.
avoid: Do not use Select for arbitrary text entry.

components.name: skeleton
components.description: Displays theme-aware loading placeholders for content, avatars, controls and images.

usage.description: Displays theme-aware loading placeholders for content, avatars, controls and images.
bestPractices: Choose a shape that matches the content and available space.
Provide meaningful labels and real loading state.
avoid: Do not show fabricated progress or leave loading states unresolved.

components.name: slider
components.description: Selects a numeric value or editable range using pointer, touch and keyboard input.

usage.description: Adjust numeric values within explicit bounds.
bestPractices: Label every handle and choose a meaningful step.
Use onChangeComplete for expensive work after a drag finishes.
avoid: Do not use a slider when users need to enter an exact unbounded number.

components.name: sonner
components.description: Displays temporary toast notifications with optional actions and provider-aware theming.

usage.description: Mount one Sonner near app root, then call toast() imperatively from event handlers. Supports toast.loading(), toast.promise(), and toast.custom() for richer async and custom notification flows.
bestPractices: Prefer short, status-oriented messages with one primary action at most.
Enable richColors when semantic status color should be visible.
avoid: Do not use toast notifications for blocking confirmations.

components.name: spinner
components.description: Indicates indeterminate loading activity.

usage.description: Use Spinner for short indeterminate waits when progress cannot be measured.
bestPractices: Prefer inline placement near the content that is loading.
Use aria labels for standalone spinners.
avoid: Do not use Spinner for determinate progress.

components.name: splitter
components.description: Creates resizable panes separated by draggable handles.

usage.description: Use Splitter for work surfaces where users need to allocate space between adjacent panes.
bestPractices: Set sensible min sizes.
Persist sizes only when the layout is user-specific.

components.name: stack
components.description: Composes children in a flex row or column with consistent spacing.

usage.description: Use Stack for simple one-dimensional layout and spacing.
bestPractices: Prefer Stack over one-off margin rules for repeated spacing.
Use semantic containers when the layout has richer meaning.
Pass breakpoint maps (e.g. direction={{ xs: 'vertical', md: 'horizontal' }}) for responsive layouts.

props.name: direction
props.description: Flex direction; accepts a breakpoint map resolved via useBreakpoint.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between children; accepts a breakpoint map.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment; accepts a breakpoint map.

components.name: statistic
components.description: Formats metrics and live count-up or countdown timers.

usage.description: Use Statistic to emphasize a single metric with a clear title and unit.

components.name: steps
components.description: Guides users through the ordered stages of a task.

usage.description: Use Steps to show progress through a multi-stage task, or to let users jump back to a stage they already visited.
bestPractices: Keep titles to one or two words and move detail into the content.
Drive the whole bar from `current` and let status be derived from position.
Provide `onChange` when revisiting a completed step is meaningful.
Prefer `orientation="vertical"` for long or narrow layouts.
avoid: Do not use Steps for peer views at the same level; use Tabs.
Do not use Steps as a passive progress indicator for a single operation; use Spinner.
Do not set `status` per item unless a step genuinely failed or was skipped.

components.name: switch
components.description: Toggles a setting on or off with immediate effect.

usage.description: Use Switch for settings that take effect immediately.
bestPractices: Use labels that describe the enabled state.
Use Checkbox when the value is submitted with a form.

components.name: table
components.description: Displays structured row and column data with selection, sorting, filtering, expandable rows, summary rows, a pinned header, and pagination hooks.

usage.description: Use Table for dense, comparable records that benefit from aligned columns.
bestPractices: Keep columns focused on the task.
Use stable row keys.
Control sorting and pagination when data is remote.
Gate secondary columns with column.responsive (e.g. ['lg']) instead of hand-rolled media queries.
avoid: Do not use Table for card-like content where comparison is not important.

components.name: tabs
components.description: Switches between peer panels within the same page context.

usage.description: Use Tabs to separate peer views without navigating away from the current task.
bestPractices: Use short tab labels.
Keep tab panels at comparable hierarchy.
avoid: Do not use Tabs for sequential steps.

components.name: tag
components.description: Displays compact labels, statuses, categories, or checkable chips.

usage.description: Use Tag for lightweight metadata or status markers. Use CheckableTag for compact filter choices.
bestPractices: Use semantic colors consistently.
Keep tag text short.
avoid: Do not encode critical state by color alone.

components.name: tao-provider
components.description: Provides global component defaults, portal scoping, and theme seed token overrides.

usage.description: Wrap an app or subtree with TaoProvider to set size, disabled, variant, and theme defaults.
bestPractices: Prefer provider-level defaults for app-wide decisions.
Use nested providers for scoped theme overrides.
avoid: Do not override derived CSS variables directly unless a theme token cannot express the change.

props.name: size
props.description: Default component size for descendants.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Default disabled state for descendants.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default field variant for descendants.

props.name: theme
props.description: Seed token overrides for the provider scope; also carries mode, compact density, and per-component token overrides.

props.name: theme.compact
props.description: Compact density: control height 32→28 and paddings one notch tighter, cascades like mode.

props.name: theme.components
props.description: Per-component token overrides (Button/Input/FormField), serialized to --tao-{component}-* CSS variables.

components.name: textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input with optional auto sizing.

usage.description: Use Textarea for longer freeform content such as descriptions, notes, and comments.
bestPractices: Set rows or autoSize based on expected content length.
Use maxLength when limits are strict.

components.name: timeline
components.description: Shows ordered events with timestamps, indicators and alternate layouts.

usage.description: Use Timeline for chronological events and their current progress.

components.name: time-picker
components.description: Select or type a time, or a time range, with Day.js values and configurable precision.

usage.description: Use TimePicker when a form needs a time without a calendar date; use TimePicker.RangePicker for start and end times.
bestPractices: Use format and step intervals that match the task.
Express unavailable times with disabledTime.
Keep controlled values synchronized in onChange.
avoid: Do not treat a timezone-free time as a complete timestamp.

components.name: tooltip
components.description: Shows a brief informational popup when hovering or focusing an element.

usage.description: Use Tooltip for short contextual hints on hover or focus. The popup is portaled and inherits the TaoProvider theme.
bestPractices: Keep tooltip text short and supplementary.
Wrap exactly one focusable trigger element.
avoid: Do not put critical information or interactive content inside a Tooltip.

props.name: title
props.description: Tooltip content; null, undefined or empty string disables the tooltip.

props.name: placement
props.description: Popup side relative to the trigger.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Show the arrow pointing at the trigger.

props.name: mouseEnterDelay
props.description: Hover delay in seconds before opening.

props.name: mouseLeaveDelay
props.description: Delay in seconds before a pointer-leave closes the tooltip; re-entering cancels the close. Esc/blur closes stay immediate.

props.name: color
props.description: Custom content background color.

components.name: tour
components.description: Guided steps anchored to page elements with a spotlight mask, custom content and accessible actions.

usage.description: Guided steps anchored to page elements with a spotlight mask, custom content and accessible actions.
bestPractices: Provide meaningful labels and concise content.
Keep controlled state synchronized through the change callbacks.

components.name: transfer
components.description: Moves selected records between searchable, paginated source and target lists.

usage.description: Assign records by moving them between source and target lists.
bestPractices: Keep targetKeys controlled and update them in onChange.
Use stable keys and searchable labels for large data sets.
avoid: Do not treat selectedKeys as assigned items; only targetKeys represents the target list.

components.name: tree
components.description: Navigate, select and check hierarchical data with keyboard navigation, lazy loading and virtual scrolling.

usage.description: Use Tree for hierarchical information. DirectoryTree adds file-explorer selection with Ctrl/Command and Shift modifiers.
bestPractices: Give every node a unique stable key.
Use controlled expandedKeys when asynchronously supplied data needs expansion.
Supply an accessible name and use height for large virtual trees.
avoid: Do not use defaultExpandAll to control data that arrives after mount.
Do not assume parent and child checks are independent unless checkStrictly is enabled.

components.name: tree-select
components.description: Select hierarchical values with search, checkable trees, lazy loading and virtual scrolling.

usage.description: Use TreeSelect when a form value comes from a hierarchy and users need to search or check multiple nodes.
bestPractices: Give every node a unique value.
Use showSearch.treeNodeFilterProp to search meaningful labels.
Use treeCheckStrictly for independent parent and child values.
avoid: Do not use default expansion props to control asynchronously arriving data.
Do not expect loadData to run while filtering.

components.name: upload
components.description: Select, transform, upload and manage files with real request progress and cancellation.

usage.description: Provide an upload action or a customRequest transport, or return false from beforeUpload to manage files locally.
bestPractices: Return Upload.LIST_IGNORE to keep rejected files out of the list.
Use onChange to synchronize controlled fileList values.
Return an abort handler from customRequest for cancellation.
avoid: Do not mark a file successful until the server confirms it.

components.name: watermark
components.description: Repeats a text or image watermark over content and inherited dialog panels.
